text:
kevin: CSM flagged a billing dispute from NovaClinic on INV-2026-22100. They say platform fee and support proration are wrong after a planned capacity swap + a negotiated 3-month pilot. Need quick alignment before renewal.
maya: drop invoice lines? I'll pull contract.
kevin: invoice extract below:
```
INV-2026-22100
Period: 2026-07-01 to 2027-06-30
Private Deployment Platform Fee (annual) - $68,000
Support: Premium (annual) - $20,000
Pilot: 3-month Dedicated pilot 2026-09-01 to 2026-11-30 (OPS-9120) - 50% capacity
Committed GPU true-up - 380 hrs @ $13/hr = $4,940
```
shawn: contract says platform fee annual non-proratable unless amendment. any signed amendment?
maya: No signed amendment in SFDC. Sales thread shows an AE note "approved pilot concession" but no legal sign-off. Opportunity OP-8820 has pilot listed.
kevin: customer insists AE promised a pro-rata platform concession for the pilot period and that renewal depends on it. CSM included meeting notes where AE said "we'll credit pilot period."
revenue-ops: recommend immediate support proration if applicable, provisional credit for platform pilot flagged "pending legal", and hold collections for 30 days.
olivia: ops confirms OPS-9120 moved 50% capacity for 92 days. Ops did not request billing change in the ticket.
shawn: Support proration calc: Premium - Standard = 20k - 8k = 12k difference. Premium effective 2026-08-15, so Standard period 7/1-8/14 = 45 days -> credit = 12,000 * 45/365 = $1,479.45. small, approve now?
maya: yes approve support credit. billing-bot, create provisional CM for $1,479.45 and tag account CUST-NOVA.
billing-bot: automated: CM-2026-960 created for $1,479.45. Reference INV-2026-22100. Status: pending revenue-ops approval.
kevin: platform pilot calc if approved: 68,000 * 0.5 * 92/365 = $8,571.23. customer asked for immediate account-level memo to avoid payment stop.
legal: we need written sales authorization or Head of Revenue waiver for any platform credit > $5k. If the AE only wrote slack note, that's insufficient.
revenue-ops: platform credit is > $5k, so escalate to Head of Revenue. prepare SAR: "Retention risk; AE verbal concession; ops confirm pilot."
olivia: attaching OPS-9120 notes to billing record now.
shawn: GPU true-up dispute: customer claims 120 hrs were test runs and should be excluded. ops confirm 110 hrs flagged as test in OPS-9120. adjust overage accordingly: new overage = 270 hrs * $13 = $3,510 -> credit $1,430 posted.
billing-bot: automated: CM-2026-961 created for GPU adjustment $1,430. Reference INV-2026-22100. Status: pending revenue-ops approval.
maya: collections asked for a written hold window. Customer requested hold until 2026-12-01. Can we grant 60 days?
revenue-ops: approve 30-day hold standard, escalate if retention risk high. Propose hold until 2026-11-01 and provide a written timeline.
kevin: customer insists on 12/01, says they'll churn if not. I'll escalate retention risk.
legal: while we escalate, provide customer a "good faith" billing note and timeline; do not commit to platform credit yet. Need sales proof for approval.
shawn: action items: (1) finance/revenue-ops approve CM-2026-960 and CM-2026-961 (@revenue-ops), (2) legal+sales: validate AE authorization or get Head of Revenue waiver (@legal + @maya), (3) ops: attach OPS-9120 and confirm test-hour breakdown (@olivia), (4) collections: set payment hold until 2026-11-01 pending escalation (@revenue-ops).
maya: I'll gather sales thread and loop Head of Revenue. kevin, please reply to customer noting support credit posted and that platform credit is under review with expected decision in 3 business days.
kevin: will do. thanks everyone. :pray:
